prompt.text:
Implement a framework-free disclosure model and export exactly `{ createDisclosureModel }` using CommonJS. `createDisclosureModel(items)` accepts an array of unique records `{ id, summary, details }`, all non-empty strings. Invalid records throw `TypeError`; duplicate IDs throw `RangeError`. It returns `snapshot()` and `toggle(id)`. Every item starts collapsed. `snapshot` preserves input order and returns fresh records `{ id, summary, details, expanded }`. `toggle` reverses only the named item's state and returns its new boolean state; an unknown ID returns `null` without changing anything. A malformed ID throws `TypeError`. Neither the input records nor any previously returned snapshot may be mutated by later operations. An empty list is valid.
